title: Blog ran on Ubuntu 16.04 for 10 years. I migrated it to FreeBSD
summary: A blogger shares their experience migrating a personal blog that ran continuously on Ubuntu 16.04 for 10 years to FreeBSD, documenting the process, challenges, and reasons for choosing FreeBSD as the new platform.
problem_solved: Migrates a long-running blog from an outdated Ubuntu 16.04 LTS system to FreeBSD with minimal downtime.
why_valuable: Provides real-world experience and practical insights for anyone considering migrating from Linux to FreeBSD, with documented lessons learned from a decade-long deployment.
